description: This file defines a React component for a role comparison page. It handles fetching roles, role competencies, performing gap analysis, and rendering a UI with competency comparisons and learning recommendations. It interacts with external data sources including Supabase database tables and API endpoints, and exports a React functional component named 'Compare'.

methods.name: difficultyScore
methods.description: Maps textual difficulty levels to a numeric score to assist ranking resource recommendations.

methods.name: competencyNameForId
methods.description: Finds the name of a competency given its ID from the list of role competencies.

methods.name: StatusPill
methods.description: A React component that displays a colored badge indicating the gap status for a competency.
